titulo: Mientras with the present indicative or the present subjunctive
subtitulo: Mientras cocinas (while) vs mientras cocines (as long as).
regla: Mientras + present indicative = while (two things at the same time). Mientras + present subjunctive = as long as (a condition).

bloques.texto: **Mientras** introduces a second clause. Its meaning, and its mood, depend on what you want to say:

filas: _while_: two actions at the same time
Mientras tú cocinas, yo lavo los trastes.

bloques.texto: Compare two almost identical sentences: **vemos tu programa mientras preparas la cena** (_while you make dinner_, both happen together) vs **vemos tu programa mientras prepares la cena** (_as long as you make dinner_, a deal).
Tip: indicative is a clock (_at the same time_). Subjunctive is a contract (_as long as_).

lista.es: ==Mientras== tú ==ves== la tele, yo lavo los trastes.
lista.en: While you watch TV, I do the dishes.
Carla does her makeup while she drives.

lista.es: Acepto tu oferta ==mientras== me ==pagues== lo que prometes.
lista.en: I accept your offer as long as you pay me what you promise.

lista.es: Puedes salir con tus amigos ==mientras== yo ==pueda== salir con los míos.
lista.en: You can go out with your friends as long as I can go out with mine.

lista.es: Vemos tu programa ==mientras preparas== la cena.
lista.en: We watch your show while you make dinner.

lista.es: Vemos tu programa ==mientras prepares== la cena.
lista.en: We'll watch your show as long as you make dinner.
As long as there are waves, I'm going to surf.

filas.t: Te presto la tabla mientras la cuidas.
Te presto la tabla mientras la cuides.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I read while I eat._
In Spanish: _You can stay as long as you help._ (tú)
Which one means _as long as_? **mientras estudias** or **mientras estudies**?
